cmd_update_app_failed_cli_stays: Error of `atlas update` after the app update failed and the CLI was rolled back to {version}.
cmd_update_app_failed_no_rollback: Error of `atlas update` when both the app update and the CLI rollback failed. {reason} is the rollback's cause.
cmd_update_ask_continue: Prompt after a failed update (the answer is typed after it). Enter alone means yes.
cmd_update_ask_now: Prompt of the update box (the answer is typed after it). Enter alone means yes. pt-BR answers with s (sim).
cmd_update_bad_tag: Cause line of `atlas update` when the tag the channel offers is not a SemVer version.
cmd_update_banner_line: Second line of the update banner. {current} and {latest} are versions (v1.2.3), {command} is the exact command to run. All three come styled; keep them as they are.
cmd_update_box_changelog: Second line of the update box. {url} is a web address, keep it.
cmd_update_box_title: First line of the box `atlas dev` prints when a newer version exists.
cmd_update_brew_latest: Line under the Homebrew command: the version the channel offers.
cmd_update_brew_title: Line of `atlas update` on a Homebrew install; the command follows on its own line.
cmd_update_cancelled: Line `atlas update` prints after a declined confirmation.
cmd_update_channel_alpha_audience: Audience of the Alpha channel (`audience` in channels.json).
cmd_update_channel_alpha_cadence: Cadence of the Alpha channel (`cadence` in channels.json).
cmd_update_channel_alpha_promise: What the Alpha channel promises. Same text as `promise` of alpha in channels.json.
cmd_update_channel_alpha_risk: Risk label of the Alpha channel (`risk_label` in channels.json).
cmd_update_channel_alpha_switch: What switching to Alpha means (`switch_to` in channels.json).
cmd_update_channel_beta_audience: Audience of the Beta channel (`audience` in channels.json).
cmd_update_channel_beta_cadence: Cadence of the Beta channel (`cadence` in channels.json).
cmd_update_channel_beta_promise: What the Beta channel promises. Same text as `promise` of beta in channels.json.
cmd_update_channel_beta_risk: Risk label of the Beta channel (`risk_label` in channels.json).
cmd_update_channel_beta_switch: What switching to Beta means (`switch_to` in channels.json).
cmd_update_channel_missing: Cause line of `atlas update channel` when the channel just chosen is not in the list it printed.
cmd_update_channel_pick: Prompt of `atlas update channel` (the answer is typed after it). {selected} is the channel followed now.
cmd_update_channel_pick_invalid: Reply of `atlas update channel` to an answer it cannot use. {selected} is the channel followed now.
cmd_update_channel_save_failed: Cause line when the file shared with Atlas Desktop that holds the update channel cannot be written. {path} is the file.
cmd_update_channel_stable_audience: Audience of the Stable channel (`audience` in channels.json).
cmd_update_channel_stable_cadence: Cadence of the Stable channel (`cadence` in channels.json).
cmd_update_channel_stable_note: Note of the Stable channel while Atlas is in alpha (`alpha_era_note` in channels.json).
cmd_update_channel_stable_promise: What the Stable channel promises, in `atlas update channel`. Same text as `promise` of stable in channels.json (a test keeps them equal).
cmd_update_channel_stable_risk: Risk label of the Stable channel (`risk_label` in channels.json).
cmd_update_channel_stable_switch: What switching to Stable means (`switch_to` in channels.json).
cmd_update_channel_switch_hint: Last line of `atlas update channel` when there is no terminal to pick a channel in. The channel names are the real arguments.
cmd_update_channels_cadence: Row of a channel in `atlas update channel`: how often builds come. Aligned with the other rows by the spaces here.
cmd_update_channels_for: Row of a channel in `atlas update channel`: who it is for.
cmd_update_channels_note: Row of a channel in `atlas update channel`: a note about it.
cmd_update_channels_offers: Row of a channel in `atlas update channel`: what it offers now.
cmd_update_channels_selected: Mark after the channel that is followed in the list of `atlas update channel`.
cmd_update_check_failed: Cause line of `atlas update` when the release lookup fails.
cmd_update_checksum_verified: Progress line of `atlas update` after the sha256 of the download matched.
cmd_update_describe_ahead: First line of the answer of `atlas update` when the running version is newer than the channel's.
cmd_update_describe_ahead_how: Last line of the answer when the running version is newer. {command} is `atlas update --downgrade`, styled; keep it.
cmd_update_describe_ahead_nothing: Second line of the answer when the running version is newer than the channel's.
cmd_update_describe_current: Answer of `atlas update` when the version that runs is the one offered.
cmd_update_describe_run: Second line of the answer when a newer version is offered. {command} is `atlas update`, styled; keep it.
cmd_update_describe_unrecognized: Answer of `atlas update` when the channel's tag is not a version. {tag} is the tag.
cmd_update_describe_upgrade: First line of the answer of `atlas update` when a newer version is offered.
cmd_update_desktop_could_not_follow: Warning of `atlas update` on a package install when the app does not reach the new version. {reason} is the cause.
cmd_update_desktop_sync_failed: Error of `atlas update` when bringing Atlas Desktop to the new version fails. {status} is the exit code or signal, already worded.
cmd_update_dev_build: Error of `atlas update` on a dev build. {path} is the binary.
cmd_update_downgrade_needs_confirmation: Error of `atlas update --downgrade` with no terminal and no --yes.
cmd_update_downgrade_not_newer: Error of `atlas update --downgrade` when the channel offers a newer build.
cmd_update_downgrading: Warning of `atlas update --downgrade` before it asks to install an older build. {channel} is stable, beta or alpha.
cmd_update_download_failed: Cause line of `atlas update` when the download or its checksum fails. {url} is the releases page, keep it.
cmd_update_downloading: Progress line of `atlas update` while the release is downloaded.
cmd_update_exit_retry: Last line after a failed update accepted inside the TUI. {command} is `atlas update`, styled.
cmd_update_exit_runner_old: Line after an update when a runner is still running. {command} is the exact commands, styled; keep it.
cmd_update_exit_updated: Success line after the update accepted inside the TUI.
cmd_update_exit_updating: Progress line printed after the TUI closes when the update was accepted inside it.
cmd_update_hint_linked: Dim hint at the start of `atlas dev` when a newer version exists but this is a dev build. {version} is the newer version.
cmd_update_host_check_error: Warning at the end of `atlas update` when `atlas hostd --reconcile` cannot start. {reason} is the system's message.
cmd_update_host_check_failed: Warning at the end of `atlas update` when `atlas hostd --reconcile` exits with a failure. {status} is the exit code or signal, already worded.
cmd_update_install_ask: Prompt that asks to install a version (the answer is typed after it). The default is no; the letter in capitals is the default. pt-BR answers with s (sim).
cmd_update_installed_by: Line of `atlas update --check` on a Linux install owned by a package manager. {manager} is pacman, apt, dnf or zypper.
cmd_update_installing: Progress line of `atlas update` while the new binary replaces the old one.
cmd_update_linked: Error of `atlas update` when the installed atlas is a link to a dev build. {path} is the installed binary.
cmd_update_lock_busy: Error of `atlas update` when the update lock is taken.
cmd_update_needs_write: One item of the list in the error of `atlas update` when an artifact cannot be replaced. {label} is Atlas CLI or Atlas Desktop (product names), {path} the file and {dir} its folder.
cmd_update_no_exe: Cause line of `atlas update` when the path of the running executable is unknown.
cmd_update_offer_downgrade: What a channel offers in `atlas update channel` when it is older than the running version.
cmd_update_offer_none: What a channel offers in `atlas update channel` when no tag is known.
cmd_update_offer_same: What a channel offers in `atlas update channel` when it is the running version.
cmd_update_offer_update: What a channel offers in `atlas update channel` when it is newer than the running version. {tag} is the release tag.
cmd_update_package_download: Line of `atlas update` pointing to the release page. {url} is a web address, keep it.
cmd_update_package_unknown_manager: Line of `atlas update` when the install is a system package and none of the supported managers exists.
cmd_update_pkg_auth_cancelled: Error when the user dismissed the pkexec password prompt (exit 126).
cmd_update_pkg_auth_unavailable: Error when pkexec has no polkit agent to ask for the password (exit 127).
cmd_update_pkg_confirm_or_run: Error of `atlas update` when a package install could run but nobody confirmed. {command} is the exact command.
cmd_update_pkg_empty_command: Internal cause line when the package install command is empty.
cmd_update_pkg_failed: Error when the package manager command exits with a failure. {command} is the command line, {status} the exit code, already worded.
cmd_update_pkg_installing: Progress line of `atlas update` while the package manager runs.
cmd_update_pkg_killed: Error when the package manager command ends without an exit code.
cmd_update_pkg_managed: Line of `atlas update` when this process cannot install the package; the command follows on its own line.
cmd_update_pkg_needs_confirmation: Error of `atlas update` on a package install with no terminal and no --yes.
cmd_update_pkg_needs_terminal: Error of `atlas update` when nothing can ask for the root password. {command} is the exact command.
cmd_update_pkg_no_escalation: Error of `atlas update` on a package install when nothing can become root.
cmd_update_pkg_run_failed: Cause line when the package manager command cannot start. {program} is its name.
cmd_update_pkg_will_run: Line before the exact command `atlas update` runs to install a system package; the command follows. {manager} is pacman, apt, dnf or zypper.
cmd_update_refreshing_skills: Progress line of `atlas update` while skills and agent hooks are refreshed with the new binary.
cmd_update_replace_failed: Cause line of `atlas update` when the executable cannot be swapped.
cmd_update_row_channel: Row of `atlas update`: the channel followed (stable, beta or alpha).
cmd_update_row_current: Row of `atlas update`: the version that runs. Indented and aligned with the rows below by the spaces here.
cmd_update_row_latest: Row of `atlas update`: the newest version the channel offers.
cmd_update_run_new_failed: Cause line of `atlas update` when the binary it just installed cannot start.
cmd_update_stage_note: Paragraph at the top of `atlas update channel` while Atlas is in alpha. Same text as `stage_note` in crates/atlas-core/data/channels.json (a test keeps them equal).
cmd_update_step_failed_error: Warning of `atlas update` when a refresh step cannot start. {reason} is the system's message.
cmd_update_step_failed_status: Warning of `atlas update` when a refresh step exits with a failure. {status} is the exit code or signal, already worded.
cmd_update_step_skipped: Warning of `atlas update` when a refresh step cannot find the atlas binary. {args} is the subcommand, {reason} the system's message.
cmd_update_switched_downgrade: Line after switching channel when the channel is older. {command} is `atlas update --downgrade`, styled.
cmd_update_switched_none: Line after switching channel when no tag is known.
cmd_update_switched_same: Line after switching channel when the channel offers the running version.
cmd_update_switched_title: First line after `atlas update channel <name>`. {channel} is the channel name, styled; keep it.
cmd_update_switched_update: Line after switching channel when the channel is newer. {command} is `atlas update`, styled.
cmd_update_tarball_empty: Error of `atlas update` when the downloaded archive holds an empty executable.
cmd_update_tarball_missing: Error of `atlas update` when the downloaded archive holds no atlas executable.
cmd_update_unwritable: Error of `atlas update` before it replaces anything. {blocked} is the list of items, separated by semicolons.
cmd_update_yank_installs: Line of the withdrawal notice: what `atlas update` will install. {command} is `atlas update`, styled; keep it.
cmd_update_yank_none: Line of the withdrawal notice when the channel has no safe version.
cmd_update_yank_replacement: Line of the withdrawal notice that names the replacement version.
cmd_update_yank_rollback: Line of the withdrawal notice when the safe version is older than the running one. {command} is `atlas update`, styled.
cmd_update_yank_withdrawn: First line of the withdrawal notice for the running version. {reason} is the maintainers' own explanation from data/yanked.json (English, shown as is).
